scope: auxiliary observational diagnosis on already exposed source and transfer assets; no fitting, no new target classifier outcomes
pair_strategy: 2048sameclass distinct-image pairs plus2048different-class pairs, class-uniform sampling
observables: mean residual squared norm before normalization
signed withinclass and betweenclass cosine change
accuracy_source: already saved source checkpoint predictions and transfer cells; compare selected step vs step0
correlation: descriptive model-level Pearson on nonzero selected models within source/shot; partial correlation of distortion with transfer accuracy delta after linear displacement adjustment; no p-values, no threshold fitting
nulls: identity has exactly zero displacement and cosine changes
global orthogonal signed-coordinate permutation preserves all pair cosine values but can move individual vectors
validation: all model and input hashes unchanged
NumPy64 sampled transformation and cosine checks
source chosen predictions and saved labels reconstruct known source/transfer accuracy
success: All36models accounted for with auditable geometry and saved-accuracy links; judge whether generic distortion beyond update size consistently tracks transfer harm. Not a causal test or a new classifier.
abandonment: unavailable/parity-failed assets; correlations undefined or inconsistent do not justify generic preservation training
